name: Introduction
fullDescription:
Welcome to the Georges River Creates internal application for librarians! This tool is designed to provide quick and easy access to information about our diverse collection of loanable items, in-house resources, creative spaces, and upcoming events.

Media Lab

The Media Lab is a digital-creation space located within Hurstville Library. It is available for community use and hosts regular workshops and events. It is equipped for a range of uses, with technology available for in-house use and also for loan.

Sound Booth

The Sound Booth is a dedicated, soundproof space perfect for recording, practicing or performing with musical instruments and audio equipment. We prioritise bookings for creative uses like vocal recording, podcast production and piano practice.

Digital Tool Library

The Digital Tool Library provides a range of digital content creation tools, including Canon DSLR cameras, GoPro cameras, and Oral History Kits.

Musical Instrument Collection

Georges River Libraries boasts one of Australia's largest musical instrument collections available for loan. With over 100 items, including acoustic and electric guitars, percussion, amplifiers, keyboards and recording equipment, you'll find everything you need to inspire learning and creativity.

Canva

Beyond our Digital Tool Library and Musical Instrument Collection, we offer a range of specialised Canva packs. These packs cover diverse uses, including podcasting, professional photography, and advanced audio recording.

Please note, these packs are for in-house use only and must be reserved in conjunction with a booking for the Media Lab or Sound Booth.

For more details on this collection, please contact the Content and Discovery team.

name: Bookings and Fees
description: Information regarding booking procedures and associated costs.
fullDescription:
In order to gain guaranteed and exclusive access to the Media Lab or Sound Booth customers are required to make a booking.

Media Lab BookingsSound Booth Bookings

All room hire is subject to the Terms and Conditions and Library Use and Membership Policy.

Information on how to book is available in the Meeting, Study and Creative Room Booking Guide.

Please note that customers may use the Media Lab or Sound Booth at any time as long as there is no booking. If customers are playing or recording audio in the Sound Booth please close the door whether or not they have booked the space in order to reduce noise. If there is a customer in the Sound Booth when there is a booking please ask the customer to vacate.
